protocol.kernel: with probability p per chain and update perform one blocked Gibbs sweep or exact equilibrium refresh; otherwise retain v but recompute its RB moment using current W
protocol.matching: same dataset/W0/initialv; Gibbs and exact-refresh share Bernoulli clocks at matching p, transition random streams independent
protocol.observation_time: W_n before update n; transition and exact/conditional/realized moments all evaluated at W_n; terminal point draws no extra transition
limitations: Conditional expected residual given W and retained state is not unconditional training bias; average across replicate states before interpreting signed projections.
Instantaneous residual norms measure noise as well as lag and are not bias estimates.
Lazy exact refresh measures cadence and aging; matching Gibbs effects can still support generic out-of-equilibrium lag.
Dataset, not stochastic replica, is the independent unit for reported population contrasts.
WW^T is a spectral diagnostic, not the exact visible coupling of a binary-hidden RBM.
